title: Overlay Manager - How to manage the views
breadcrumb: Overlay Manager - How to manage the views

blocks.html: Overlay Manager sorts everything on your map into categories so you can clean up the picture, find a marker fast, and control exactly what you see.

slides.title: Open Overlay Manager
slides.html: Select the Overlay Manager icon to open the list of categories: Team, Markers, Alerts, Data Packages, Navigation, Shapes, Hashtags and more. Tap a category to drill into its items.

slides.title: Show or hide layers
slides.html: Tap the Visibility (eye) button to toggle a layer on or off. A white eye means visible, an outlined eye means some items are hidden, and an eye with a line through it means hidden.

slides.title: Filter markers by side and domain
slides.html: In the Markers category select Slicer. Tap F, N and the others to toggle Friendly, Neutral, Hostile and Unknown; the top letters cover Space, Air, Ground, Sea and Subsurface.

slides.title: Show only your own markers
slides.html: Tap List, then Filters. Turn on Self Authored to show only markers you placed on this device and hide everyone else's, then tap OK.

slides.title: Search the overlays
slides.html: Tap the Search icon in the Overlay Manager toolbar to find an overlay by name. Pick a category first to narrow the results.

slides.title: Clear temporary items with COP Refresh
slides.html: Tap COP Refresh to clear temporary items from the map: other users' self-markers, their SPIs and ADSB aircraft tracks. Confirm in the window that appears.

slides.title: Tag items with Hashtags
slides.html: Open the Hashtags category and tap + to create a tag. Hashtags group related items so you can search and filter by them later; add the tag and select Done.

slides.title: Turn on the MGRS grid
slides.html: In Overlay Manager open Other Overlays and toggle Grid Lines with its eye icon. The MGRS grid is drawn over the map and adjusts automatically as you zoom.

slides.title: Toggle the Heatmap overlay
slides.html: In Other Overlays, toggle Heatmap Overlay to shade the terrain by elevation. Off-Screen Indicators can be toggled here too, pointing to nearby markers just outside your view.

slides.title: Edit overlay colour and thickness
slides.html: For file overlays (Shapefiles, KMZ, DRW) tap Edit (the pencil icon) in the listing. Drag the Line Thickness slider and pick a Color to make the overlay easier to read.
